name: Warehouse Requests Closed This Month
query: SELECT    owner_name,    due_date AS "Due Date",    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = '--None--' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS None_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Product Testing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Product_Testing_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Build Machine' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Machine_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Build Locker' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Locker_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Build Kiosk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Kiosk_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Build Vault' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Vault_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Wrap Ready' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wrap_Ready_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Print Labels' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Print_Labels_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Device Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Device_Request_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Shipping Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Shipping_Request_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Reader Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Reader_Request_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Transport/Relocate Equipment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Transport_Relocate_Equipment_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Shipping Quote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Shipping_Quote_Count,    SUM(CASE WHEN request_reason = 'Other' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Other_CountFROM    `tabWarehouse Request` WHERE    status = 'Closed'    AND YEAR(due_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())    AND MONTH(due_date) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE())GROUP BY    owner_name;
